# Draft:YouWare

YouWare is a vibe coding platform and creative community that helps users to build web applications through natural language prompts. Founded in March 2025 by Leon Ming, the company is headquartered in Shenzhen, with offices in the United States and Japan. YouWare has grown to over 500,000 monthly active users within eight months of launch.
History
Founding and early development
YouWare was founded March 2025 by Leon Ming, a former product manager at OnePlus and founding product team member at ByteDance. According to the company, the platform originated when Ming noticed creators sharing screen recordings of AI-generated games on X (formerly Twitter) who lacked a way to host their code or share interactive experiences.
Recognizing this gap, Ming developed the first iteration of YouWare in a single evening, launching it as an HTML-to-website tool that allowed users to paste code and create live, shareable websites.
The company reported that within 24 hours of launch, over 1,000 projects were uploaded to the platform and that the platform exceeded 1 million visits by the 48-hour mark.
Brand identity
The company's name is a portmanteau of "your" and "software." The company's logo references the Chinese knot.
Funding and valuation
In 2025, YouWare secured $50 million in pre-seed funding led by IDG Capital and 5Y Capital. The company reported reaching a valuation of $200 million as of November 2025.
Products and features
Product philosophy
YouWare states that its product development emphasizes responsiveness to new technology and user focused design. The company positions its software as a tool intended to assist with the human endeavor of creativity, rather than replace it.
Core technology
YouWare operates as a vibe coding platform. Users describe desired projects in natural language, and Youware's AI coding agents design, code, and deploy applications automatically. The company company uses the term vibe coding to describe this process, distinguishing it from traditional programming that requires knowledge of specific programming languages.
Product evolution
* March 2025: YouWare first launches with Text-to-Website, HTML upload & deploy, Remix, user accounts, and passcode-protected sharing, establishing its core prompt-to-live-project workflow.
* April–June 2025: The platform launches its initial community features, including  social + creator experience with reactions, comments, saving, notifications, stronger file uploads (folders/multi-file), affiliate links + badges, and creator discovery improvements. YouWare also begins expanding backend capabilities through early managed integrations (e.g., Supabase).
* May–July 2025: YouWare integrates MCP tool support and shipped foundational creation controls: TabTabTab, Boost, project settings/sharing, and stream continuation. A full subscription + credits system also launches, adding clearer usage structure and paid tiers.
* July–August 2025: YouWare incorporates React support, a redesigned Explore + project experience, and VS Code/Cursor plugins for smoother workflow. Planning improvements also launch via Plan Mode.
* August–September 2025: Rollout of Visual Editing (on-canvas edits) and real-time credit tracking. YouWare also introduces a built-in backend system (database, auth, edge functions).
* September 2025: YouWare releases Creator Studio, a larger template library, and the Compliance Center. YouWare also integrates Nano Banana for creative workflows.
* September–October 2025: YouWare ships improved mobile and workflow upgrades: the iOS/Android app, a redesigned editor with Code View, and early mobile UX improvements like notifications and faster search.
* November–December 2025: Credit Care, Auto Fix, a full Help Center, Custom Domain support (guided DNS), and Video Understanding are released across models. In late December, YouBase Beta opens, bringing production backend primitives (auth, database, storage, edge functions) into the platform.
* January 2026: YouWare expands multimodal + account infrastructure with CoView, Chat Mode, mobile subscriptions, and cross-project Assets Management. Third-party login also released.
The company continues to catalog integrations, patches, and product iteration updates in its YouWare Changelog.
Product features
YouWare offers several features for code generation and project management, including:
* Model Switching: Users can select from multiple AI coding models, including GPT-5-Codex and Claude 4.5 Sonnet.
* Credit Care: A refund system that allows users to reverse changes and recover credits spent on unsatisfactory outputs.
* Auto-fix Mode: Automatically detects, analyzes, and resolves bugs or errors during the creation process without requiring manual debugging.
* TabTabTab: An intelligent prompt prediction system that anticipates and completes user prompts.
* Visual Editing: An interface for modifying page elements such as text, images, fonts and colors directly on-canvas.
* Boost: A one-click feature that automatically elevates a project's visual quality by refining color palettes, typography, layouts, and animations.
* YouBase: A built-in production backend that enables users to ship full-stack, business-ready applications from initial concept.
* CoView: A feature that enables users to communicate with AI agents through screen recording combined with voice narration. The feature addresses communication inefficiencies in AI-assisted development by allowing users to visually demonstrate interface issues, bugs, and design requirements rather than describing them in text.
Mobile application
The YouWare mobile app, available on iOS and Android, launched in October 2025. The mobile version includes voice-driven creation, instant notifications when projects are complete, and the ability to turn photos of whiteboard sketches or mockups into functional prototypes. The mobile platform leverages smartphone sensors to enable motion-driven and voice-driven creation.
Business model
YouWare operates on a credit-based monetization system common to other AI platforms, where users purchase credits to generate and modify projects. The company has indicated plans to expand into premium tools, AI agent marketplaces, and enterprise integrations.
Use cases
According to YouWare, the platform serves three primary user segments:
Side-Hustle Builders or AI Enthusiasts: Users with little or no coding experience. Users who are exploring AI-powered creation as a new income stream, typically using YouWare for client websites, creative tools, or niche content platforms while maintaining full-time employment.
Small Businesses and Solopreneurs: Users lacking coding experience but with established business models who use YouWare for lead generation, client conversion, and brand presentation.
Professionals and Knowledge Workers: Individuals in education, healthcare, and design fields using YouWare to improve workflow efficiency and content presentation in their day-to-day work.
Reception and growth
The company reported that it achieved 500,000 users within eight months of launch and over 600,000 monthly active users by 2025. As of late 2025, the company has offices in Shenzhen, the United States, and Japan.
The platform has shown particularly strong adoption in Japan, which it attributes to the platform's design resonating with Japanese creative aesthetics.
Company leadership
Leon Ming (明超平), born in 1995 in Huangshi, Hubei, serves as founder and Chief Executive Officer (CEO). Ming graduated from Wuhan University in 2018 with a degree in automation.
He joined OnePlus as a product manager for the mobile imaging division before transitioning to ByteDance in 2020, where he led the mobile tools team behind Jianying (known internationally as CapCut), a video editing application. The company states that during his tenure, he helped grow the product from 1 million to over 100 million daily active users.
In August 2023, Ming joined Moonshot AI to lead core product efforts, directing development of Noisee, an AI music video application, and later managing the Kimi product experience.
